verification_report.summary: The positive-density scaling argument from an ambient-open captured set is logically sound conditional on the intended MQAR formulas, and the displayed score-origin and normal-attraction calculations are internally consistent. The submitted markdown nevertheless does not pass strict verification: foundational model definitions and several numbered identities are omitted, the global measure-zero classification of exceptional value directions is not proved from the local Hessian analysis, and later access/data-property claims rely on absent definitions. No external-paper references were present.

gaps.issue: The supplied Statement and Proof do not define the frozen MQAR population, the attention coefficients a_{qd}, b_{qd}, the delivered-kernel map κ, the access quantity, or the cited equations (5), (9)–(17), (21)–(24), and (29)–(30). Consequently the claim that all of those equations are exact—and later deductions that depend on them—cannot be verified from the submitted markdown.

gaps.issue: The proof says that derivatives of “all four tensors in (11)–(12) cancel” and that dividing (34) yields (16)–(17), but neither the tensors nor those equations are displayed and the cancellations/definitions are not supplied. The unavailable numerical-audit script cannot replace these missing mathematical steps.

The local Hessian index calculations do not by themselves prove the asserted global null classification. The proof invokes an “elementary local center-stable graph construction” without stating its hypotheses or constructing the required local sets, and monotonicity alone does not show that every orbit which never reaches an arbitrary fixed positive gain converges into one of those local stable strata. A convergence/omega-limit argument and a countable flow-back/null-set argument are missing.

The access functional A_κ and the cited identity (17) are not defined in the supplied Statement or Proof. Therefore the equality between its time integral and (N/2)log(R(0)/(1/4)) cannot be checked; it is only asserted by reference to omitted material.

The claims that the frozen population has every listed Section 2 data property and that this is an N9 counterexample cannot be verified because Section 2, N9, and the definitions of those properties are absent from the supplied input.

record.repair_hints: Make the proof self-contained by supplying the frozen-population definition, exact softmax coefficients, κ and A_κ, and the full statements of equations (5), (9)–(17), (21)–(24), and (29)–(30); then explicitly derive the balance cancellations and the log-risk/access identity rather than relying on the unavailable audit script. For the exceptional-direction claim, state and verify the applicable center-stable theorem, prove convergence (or sufficient omega-limit localization) for the spherical analytic gradient flow, and show that countably many flow-backs of the local positive-codimension stable sets remain null. Finally, include the Section 2/N9 definitions and verify each asserted data property, or delete those ancillary claims. The core refutation can also be shortened to the positive cone U_v, fast transfer, uniform tube, and captured-open-cone lemmas, avoiding the unused global exceptional-direction classification.

verification_report.summary: The proof is correct as a refutation of T_small. Its population-risk algebra, factor gradients, conserved balances, gain and access identities, and score-origin calculation are exact. The value-clock and fast-transfer arguments uniformly move a positive-measure open cone of small initializations to a scale-uniform attracting tube around a 35-dimensional wrong critical manifold. Negative symmetric Q^T K orientation contracts the six embedding-contrast directions, the gain direction is damped, all tangential drift is integrable, and captured trajectories are global with R→1/4. Hence epsilon A is contained in the failure set at every sufficiently small scale for one fixed bounded ambient-open A, yielding a strictly positive lower density at the origin and disproving both T_small and T_ray. The measure-theoretic equivalence with all absolutely continuous base laws is also valid. No external-paper theorem is used, and the stated local numerical audit was reproduced.
